description: Apply (or replace) accessories on a spawned avatar session and optionally set a pose. Pass accessoryIds to set the full accessory list (empty array clears them). Pass pose to switch animations. Returns the updated viewer URL.

accessoryIds.description: Full list of accessory ids to wear. Allowed: hat-baseball, hat-beanie, hat-cowboy, glasses-round, glasses-shades, earrings-hoops, earrings-studs. Empty array clears.

pose.description: Pose preset. Allowed: idle, wave, thumbs_up, dab, t_pose, sit, point, salute, cheer.

name: dress_avatar
title: Apply accessories + pose to a spawned avatar
